name: What is the installation process for glass partitions?

mainEntity.name: What is the installation process for glass partitions?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation process for glass partitions typically begins with a site survey and detailed measurements, followed by the fabrication of custom glass panels and framing. Once materials are ready, the on-site installation involves preparing the area, mounting the frames, carefully positioning and securing the glass panels, and finally installing any doors or hardware. Throughout this process, Hometelligent Inc. ensures minimal disruption and adheres to safety standards, often coordinating with other trades to maintain project schedules.
acceptedAnswer.description: Process includes site survey, fabrication, on-site preparation, frame mounting, panel installation, and hardware setup.
